description: Delivery surface: the Hono local HTTP server exposing the 5 REST endpoints that mirror the API Gateway design (no auth = documented MVP gap), with zod input validation and centralized error handling at every boundary, plus the single-page web UI under web/ that reuses product-final.html's look/content and drives the full demo against the local server. In-process server tests. Depends on FEAT-002. Mirrors plan.md items 5,6.
steps: Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\server\schemas.ts: zod schemas for the upload body ({filename, text?, contentBase64?, metadata?}), the decision body ({findingId, action:'ACCEPT'|'REJECT', justification}) with justification required when action==='REJECT', and the search query (q non-empty). Export typed parsers that return a validation error object instead of throwing.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\server\errors.ts: an AppError type + toHttp(err) mapping to {status, body} (400 validation, 404 not found, 500 fallback) and a safe logger that uses config.redactForLog (no PII, no secrets, no request bodies with document text).

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\server\routes.ts: handlers wired to getProviders()/runPipeline — POST /documents/upload (runs pipeline, 201 {documentId,status,extracted,findings,alerts}), GET /documents/:id (200 record / 404), GET /documents/:id/draft (200 {documentId,version,format,content}; ?download=1 sets Content-Disposition attachment), POST /documents/:id/decision (validate, record via TraceStore, 200 {decisionId,recordedAt}; 400/404), GET /search?q= (200 {query,results}). Validate inputs via schemas.ts; catch and map errors via errors.ts; never leak stack traces.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\server\app.ts: `buildApp()` returns a configured Hono instance with the routes mounted, permissive CORS for the local UI origin, and a static handler serving web/ (so the SPA and API share one origin). Export buildApp — do NOT call .listen here (keeps it testable in-process).

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\server\index.ts: import buildApp, start the bun server on config.port, and log a clear one-line WARNING that this local server has NO authentication and that Amazon Cognito is the production auth boundary (the MVP security gap). This file is only run by `bun run dev` — never by tests.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\web\index.html: port the 4-screen layout and visual content from c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\product-final.html (cargar -> datos -> borradores -> exportar, Tailwind CDN). Relax the mock's Content-Security-Policy so connect-src allows the local API origin (http://localhost:8787). Add element hooks/ids that web/app.js binds to.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\web\app.js: vanilla JS that (1) uploads a bundled sample (fetch POST /documents/upload), (2) renders extracted data + findings + risk alerts into screen 2/3, (3) loads and shows/downloads the draft (GET /documents/:id/draft), (4) records a decision (POST /documents/:id/decision) and reflects it. Handle fetch errors visibly (no silent failure). Include a visible 'MVP: sin autenticacion' banner.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\tests\server\server.integration.test.ts (bun:test): build the app with buildApp() and exercise every endpoint purely in-process via app.fetch(new Request(url, init)) — NO network listener, NO blocking. Cover: upload returns 201 with findings; GET document 200 and unknown id 404; GET draft 200 with markdown content; decision happy path 200; decision missing justification on REJECT 400; search 200 with results. Assert status codes and body shape.
acceptance_criteria: `bun test tests/server` passes; all endpoints verified in-process (no socket opened, nothing left running).
Invalid inputs are rejected at the boundary with 400 and a helpful message; unknown document ids return 404; no stack traces or document text leak into logs/responses.
The server boot path logs an explicit no-auth warning, and web/ carries a visible no-auth banner.
web/index.html visually matches product-final.html's structure and web/app.js completes the upload->findings->draft->decision flow against the local API.
findings:
DELIVERED (bun 1.4.4). Verification: `bunx tsc --noEmit` clean (whole project); `bun test tests/server` => 12 pass / 0 fail / 39 expect() across 1 file. No socket opened, nothing left blocking; test temp dir under .data/test-feat003-* removed in afterAll (no artifacts left).

FILES CREATED (import with .ts extensions, same convention as FEAT-001/002):
- src/server/schemas.ts
- src/server/errors.ts
- src/server/routes.ts
- src/server/app.ts
- src/server/index.ts
- web/index.html
- web/app.js
- tests/server/server.integration.test.ts

SCHEMAS (src/server/schemas.ts): zod. Exports uploadBodySchema, decisionBodySchema, searchQuerySchema + typed parsers parseUploadBody/parseDecisionBody/parseSearchQuery returning a DISCRIMINATED ParseResult<T> ({ok:true,data} | {ok:false,error:ValidationError}) — they NEVER throw. ValidationError={message, issues:[{path,message}]}. Upload requires non-empty filename AND at least one of text/contentBase64 (refine, path:['text']); objects are .strict() so unknown keys are rejected. Decision requires non-empty justification only when action==='REJECT' (refine, path:['justification']); ACCEPT allows an empty/omitted justification. Search requires non-empty q.

ERRORS (src/server/errors.ts): class AppError(status,code,publicMessage,details?) with code ErrorCode='VALIDATION'|'NOT_FOUND'|'INTERNAL'; factories badRequest/validationFailed/notFound/internal; HttpStatus=200|201|400|404|500 (exported — used by routes via `satisfies HttpStatus`). toHttp(err) => {status, body:{error:{code,message,details?}}}: AppError keeps status+publicMessage (+safe validation issues as details); ANY other thrown value collapses to a generic 500 {error:{code:'INTERNAL',message:'Error interno del servidor'}} — no stack/message leak. logError(context,err) writes a redacted (config.redactForLog) one-line stderr note for NON-AppError failures only; request bodies / document text are never passed to it.

ROUTES (src/server/routes.ts): export registerRoutes(app:Hono, getBundle:BundleResolver) + type BundleResolver=()=>Promise<ProviderBundle>. Endpoints (all wrapped by guard() which maps throws via toHttp and logs unexpected ones): GET /health (liveness {status:'ok',auth:'none'}); POST /documents/upload (parse+validate -> runPipeline -> 201 {documentId,status,extracted,findings,alerts}); GET /documents/:id (200 record / 404); GET /documents/:id/draft (picks highest-numbered version, reads storage.get(storageKey); 200 {documentId,version,format:'markdown',content}; ?download=1 adds Content-Disposition attachment; 404 if no doc / no version / blob missing); POST /documents/:id/decision (validate -> 404 if doc unknown -> traceStore.recordDecision -> 200 {decisionId,recordedAt}); GET /search?q= (validate -> searchIndex.search -> 200 {query,results}). JSON body parse failure -> 400. Note: justification defaults to '' for ACCEPT when omitted.

APP (src/server/app.ts): buildApp(options?:{providers?:ProviderBundle}):Hono — mounts cors({origin:'*'}) + routes + static web/ (GET '/','/index.html','/app.js' read from <root>/web via node:fs; others 404). NO .listen (testable in-process). CRITICAL: the provider bundle is built ONCE and memoized (memoizedBundle) and shared across requests — the LocalSearchIndex is in-memory, so upload-then-search must hit the same instance. buildApp() with no args lazily calls getProviders() (honours AIDLC_PROVIDER); tests inject an isolated bundle via buildApp({providers}).

INDEX (src/server/index.ts): run ONLY by `bun run dev`/`start` (never by tests). Imports buildApp, logs a loud one-line NO-AUTH console.warn (Cognito = prod auth boundary, MVP gap), then Bun.serve({port:config.port, fetch:app.fetch}) and logs the listen URL. Uses the Bun global (bun-types).

WEB (web/index.html + web/app.js): ports the 4-screen product-final.html layout (cargar->datos->borradores->exportar, Tailwind CDN). CSP relaxed: connect-src now allows 'self' + http://localhost:8787 + http://127.0.0.1:8787; script-src adds 'self' for app.js. Visible amber no-auth banner (#auth-banner: 'MVP: sin autenticacion') + a red global error strip (#app-error) so fetch failures are never silent. app.js (vanilla, IIFE) bundles the inconsistencias sample inline, then: POST /documents/upload -> render extracted table + findings/alerts cards (ACCEPT/REJECT with required justification on reject) -> GET draft (shown as <pre>) -> POST decision -> refresh record + decisions log -> GET draft?download=1 triggers a Blob download. API_BASE='' (same origin when served by Hono) or http://localhost:8787 when opened as file://.

TEST (tests/server/server.integration.test.ts): buildApp({providers}) with an isolated bundle (LocalStorage/LocalTraceStore under .data/test-feat003-<uuid>, fresh in-memory LocalSearchIndex); every call via app.fetch(new Request('http://local.test...')) — no socket. Covers: upload 201 w/ findings+alerts; upload missing filename 400; non-JSON body 400; GET doc 200 (versions>=1); unknown id 404; GET draft 200 (markdown contains 'Ficha Técnica de Negociación'); draft?download=1 Content-Disposition attachment; decision ACCEPT 200; decision REJECT-without-justification 400; decision unknown-doc 404; search 'valor' 200 with >=1 result whose documentId matches; empty q 400. afterAll rm's the temp dir.

FOR FINALIZE STEP: FEAT-004 (aws thin bundle) + FEAT-005/README/iac (plan items 8-10) are NOT part of FEAT-003 and remain. The provider selector already expects src/providers/aws/index.ts exporting buildAwsProviders(config). The server runs today via `bun run dev` (listens on PORT=8787) serving the SPA at http://localhost:8787. README should document: no local auth (Cognito is prod boundary), the 5 endpoints, and `bun run dev` + open the root URL. No git was run (git absent).
